scope: These checks judge the OFFLINE god-view map artifact (one composed PNG: a labeled grid of every zone's full tile map, a header strip of persisted counters, seal-state stamps, a home marker). It is a reference artifact, not a gameplay frame: no creatures, no HUD bars, no controls strip are expected. Judge legibility and honesty of the world state it claims to show.

checks.check: Thirteen labeled zone panels are present (ZONE 1 through ZONE 8, HUB 1, BASEMENT 1, BASEMENT 2, DUNGEON 1, TEST 1), each showing a full tile grid distinct from the dark backing - no panel is empty, cropped, or duplicated.

Within each panel, walls read against floor tiles and each zone's palette differs from its neighbors - the panels read as different places, not copies. The original surface zones stay the warm clay/bone family; ZONE 7 reads as a green meadow-with-town; ZONE 8 reads as a forest-and-lake green family with a large water mass clearly distinct from its land; the FLOOR -1 panels (BASEMENT 1/2, DUNGEON 1) read darker than the surface zones (depth darkens palettes).

Inside ZONE 7's town half, a small uniform ring of tiles around one gold way reads as a distinct authored feature (the drained well and its opened hole) - a deliberate basin, not corruption or a rendering hole.

Every seal-gated way carries a SEALED or OPEN text stamp; OPEN stamps sit in the gate-gold family and SEALED stamps in the plain chrome tone, and at least one of each state is legible in this artifact.
Exactly ONE panel is framed with the bright white home border and its label carries the HOME suffix - the home zone is unambiguous at a glance.
The top header strip reads BANKED N / MARKS K / PROVISIONS P / BOSS 1 DEFEATS D with legible numerals, matching flat placeholder register (no fiction names anywhere in the artifact).
No tearing, no corrupted tiles, no text drawn over text illegibly, no obviously missing glyphs.
